activity.notes: Augustine was ordained priest at Hippo in 391 and succeeded to the bishopric about 396, serving until his death during the Vandal siege in 430. ATLAS records his major ecclesiastical office in Roman Africa; he was not a ruler of Romano-Maghreb, Phoenicia, or Rome.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Augustine of Hippo
sources.citation_text: The Stanford Encyclopedia states that Augustine was ordained a priest at Hippo in 391, succeeded the local bishop about 396, and remained bishop until his death in 430.

review_context.correction_note: Register his historically significant episcopal office in Roman Africa rather than political sovereignty.
